name: Settings
description: Merge settings into per-user configuration files inside the dev container: VS Code's remote settings and Claude Code's user settings.

vscode.description: JSON object merged into VS Code's Remote [Dev Container] settings (~/.vscode-server/data/Machine/settings.json). See the README for how to quote it.

claude.description: JSON object merged into Claude Code's user settings (~/.claude/settings.json). See the README for how to quote it.
